In pose 4 the NEAR foot bends BACKWARD under the rump while the FAR leg is planted. Match the reference hand-painted storybook outlines and palette. No scene, floor, shadows, letters, grid, text, particles, duplicate poses, cropping, or background colour. This will be played cyclically 1-2-3-4-1 to depict actual walking.
